title: Stock adjustments
subtitle: Documented manual corrections to on-hand stock

create.title: New stock adjustment
create.subtitle: Every correction is a document: what moved, by how much, and why
create.locationHelp: One document covers one location. Correcting a second location means a second document.
create.notePlaceholder: Why is this correction being made?
create.emptyLines: Add at least one line to record a correction.
create.openingBalanceHint: Setting a product's opening balance? Use the product editor's opening quantity and cost — an adjustment records a correction, not an opening balance.
create.duplicateLine: That product is already on this adjustment. Edit the existing line instead.
create.loadFailed: Could not read the current quantity for that product at this location.

line.lotRequired: Choose the lot this correction draws down.
line.lotEmpty: No lots hold stock here yet.

detail.title: Stock adjustment {{number}}
detail.postConfirmBody: Posting writes one stock movement per line and cannot be undone. A posted adjustment is corrected by a contra document, never edited.

quickModal.title: Adjust stock
quickModal.supplierReceiptHint: Receiving from a supplier with a price? Record a goods receipt instead.
quickModal.loadFailed: Could not read the current quantity. Close and try again.

refusal.title: This correction was not applied
refusal.STOCK_MOVED_SINCE_AUTHORING: Stock moved after you started this correction. Re-anchor to the current quantities, or apply your change on top of them anyway.
refusal.ADJUSTMENT_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: This decrease is larger than the unreserved stock. Applying it anyway records the stock as gone while the reservations stay promised.
refusal.INSUFFICIENT_BATCH_STOCK: The selected lot does not hold enough stock for this decrease.
refusal.BATCH_REQUIRED_FOR_LINE: This product holds stock in lots here, so a decrease must name the lot it draws down.
refusal.BATCH_NOT_APPLICABLE: That lot does not belong to this product at this location.
refusal.USE_BATCH_WRITE_OFF: This product is lot-tracked. Record damage and write-offs through the batch write-off, which also posts the accounting entry.
refusal.LINE_TENANT_MISMATCH: One of these products belongs to a different tenant and cannot be adjusted here.
refusal.INVALID_ADJUSTMENT_STATE: This adjustment is no longer in a state that allows this action.
refusal.ADJUSTMENT_ALREADY_CORRECTED: This adjustment has already been corrected.
refusal.CANNOT_CORRECT_A_CORRECTION: A correction cannot itself be corrected.
refusal.LOCATION_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have permission to act on this location.
refusal.generic: The stock adjustment could not be completed.
refusal.POST_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: You can create this adjustment but not post it. Save it as a draft for someone with posting rights to review.

validation.quantity: Enter a quantity with at most 4 decimal places.
validation.nonZero: Enter a quantity greater than zero — a zero change is not a correction.
validation.lotRequired: Choose the lot this correction draws down.
